name: @schoolos/workspaces
description: SchoolOS workspace directory: stable logical personal and course workspaces, provisioned lazily per student, with a lifecycle derived from term state and retention, legal hold, term close and rollover, and promotion links, and a retention job that deletes eligible workspaces' storage. Every read goes through the ABAC policy engine. A library, not a deployable Worker. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the directory's Durable Object SQLite store.
